# Generated by tools/freeze_constraints.sh. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Every package the api and tests images install, at the version they install it. This includes the
# dependencies of our dependencies, which requirements.txt does not name. The Dockerfile passes this
# file to every pip install as `-c`. pip installs only what requirements.txt asks for, but each
# package, named or pulled in, must be the version written here. A rebuild in a month installs the
# same set as today's.
#
# **After changing a pin or adding a package in requirements.txt (or the Dockerfile's pyarrow), re-freeze:** run
# tools/freeze_constraints.sh, read the diff it prints, and commit both files. A bumped pin that
# disagrees with this file makes the build refuse. A NEW package is not refused, only left
# unconstrained, which is why `tools/freeze_constraints.sh --check` compares the built image with
# this file.
